summary: Implemented the TimeElapsedColumn feature and Palette.__rich__ in the repository. Changes: rich/progress.py (Task.finished_time field, finished property based on it, capture/clear logic in update, advance, reset, and the TimeElapsedColumn class), rich/default_styles.py (progress.elapsed yellow), rich/palette.py (__rich__ with local imports and TYPE_CHECKING table import), tests/test_palette.py (new test_rich_cast), tests/test_progress.py (new test_time_elapsed_column; test_columns updated with TimeElapsedColumn and hand-derived expected output), CHANGELOG.md (Unreleased/Added entry). No tests were run, per instructions; the test_columns expected output was derived by hand from a clock-read trace and is unverified until the suite runs. Nothing was committed. Note: tests/test_columns.py is an unrelated Columns test; the progress test_columns in tests/test_progress.py was the target.
